issue_context.title: [Bug] 500 on download pull-diff/patch file of a merged with deleted HeadBranch
comments: solution: if pull is merged and Head branch deleted use merge-commit to get diff or patch

related if merged and branch not deleted: pull-diff/patch is empty

conclusion: only use pull.MergedCommitID
